description: CI-003 hotspot ledger (SPCC §4.4). Baseline line counts are the real counts at task creation; the ledger may only shrink (never grow) unless a split task or an architect-written exception explicitly authorizes a transition. Do not inflate a number to turn a guard green. PROCESS LESSON (CI-003 PR #95): after any `cargo fmt` auto-fix, the architecture guards MUST be re-run locally before pushing; a fmt-driven reflow once silently broke the hotspot baseline.

adjustments.reason: E-001 fix: 3 proxy test clients switched to no_proxy builder form; cargo fmt reflowed the single-line form into a 4-line expansion. This is the authorized cost of an approved touch (#94), not silent growth.
